description: This file defines an abstract class 'Snippet' for testing code snippets related to PDF rendering using PDFsharp library. It includes methods for rendering snippets as PDF or PNG, drawing headers, boxes, and other graphics utilities, as well as some static factory methods for creating PDFs. It also contains extension methods for XGraphics measurement boxes.

classes.name: Snippet
classes.description: Abstract base class for code snippets used in testing PDF rendering features.

methods.name: DrawNotSupportedFeature
methods.description: Draws a message indicating a feature is not supported in the current build.

methods.name: DrawHeader
methods.description: Draws a header string with type and render target info.

methods.name: DrawPdfHeader
methods.description: Draws a header indicating PDF output.

methods.name: DrawPngHeader
methods.description: Draws a header indicating PNG output.

methods.name: RenderSnippet
methods.description: Abstract method to render the snippet content on a graphics object.

methods.name: RenderSnippetAsPdf
methods.description: Renders the snippet as a PDF document with specified size and orientation.

methods.name: RenderSnippetAsPng
methods.description: Renders the snippet as a PNG image (conditional compilation).

methods.name: CreatePdfPage
methods.description: Creates and configures a new PDF page for the document.

methods.name: BeginBox
methods.description: Starts drawing a box with specified options and description.

methods.name: DrawTiledBox
methods.description: Draws a tiled pattern within a specified rectangle.

methods.name: DrawCenterPoint
methods.description: Draws a small ellipse at the center of a box.

methods.name: DrawAlignmentGrid
methods.description: Draws grid lines for alignment, with optional highlights.

methods.name: DrawArtBox
methods.description: Draws a dotted rectangle and crossing lines to illustrate an art box.

methods.name: Pentagram
methods.description: Property returning points of a pentagram in a unit circle.

methods.name: GetPentagram
methods.description: Returns scaled points of a pentagram centered at a given point.

methods.name: HelloWorldFactory
methods.description: Creates a simple 'Hello World' PDF document, optionally with custom message.

methods.name: GfxForLastPage
methods.description: Gets an XGraphics object for the last page of a PDF document.
